grades.reason: Describes the hvip hypervisor interrupt register. It says nothing about writing to the constant-zero register (x0).
Describes czero.nez, which writes zero to rd under a condition. It does not say what happens when an instruction writes to the hardwired zero register x0, so it doesn't answer the query.
Describes cache-block zero instructions that store zeros to memory. This is unrelated to writing to a zero register.
Covers OS zero-filling of memory pages with virtual memory. It has nothing to do with a constant-zero register.
